description: This file declares the DataReaderV2 class, which implements the IDataReader interface for reading media data segments. It includes class members for media source type, buffer pointer, data offset, and number of frames, and provides a method to read data segments.

classes.name: DataReaderV2
classes.description: A class that reads media data segments from a buffer, implementing the IDataReader interface.

methods.name: DataReaderV2
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the DataReaderV2 with media source type, buffer, data offset, and number of frames.

methods.name: readData
methods.description: Reads and returns a vector of media segments from the buffer.
